tmvg_esp32.name=TMVG ESP32 Gadget

# Standard options

# Menu to select board type, not really necessary

tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.external=external
tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.external.tmvg.defines=-DEXTERNAL

# The FQDN will have TMVGRevision=v1, the 'version 1' is shown in the menu

# We have OLED available for this type

tmvg_esp32.build.defines={tmvg.defines} -DOLED_AVAILABLE
